summary.en: A conversational interface and dialogue-tuned model that brought instruction-following AI to a mass audience
summary.zh: 通过对话界面与对话调优模型把指令式 AI 带给大众用户

description.en:
ChatGPT launched publicly on November 30, 2022 as a research preview built from the InstructGPT lineage. It used supervised dialogue data and reinforcement learning from human feedback so the model could answer follow-up questions, acknowledge mistakes and respond within a continuing conversation.

The accessible chat interface dramatically lowered the barrier to trying a general-purpose language model. Its rapid adoption changed public expectations for search, writing, coding, education and human-computer interaction, while exposing reliability and safety limits at unprecedented scale.
description.zh:
ChatGPT 于 2022 年 11 月 30 日作为研究预览公开发布，技术路线承接 InstructGPT。它使用监督式对话数据和基于人类反馈的强化学习，使模型能够回答追问、承认错误，并在连续对话中作出回应。

易用的聊天界面大幅降低了体验通用语言模型的门槛。它的快速普及改变了公众对搜索、写作、编程、教育和人机交互的预期，也以前所未有的规模暴露出可靠性与安全局限。

role.zh: OpenAI 对话式 AI 产品

notes.en: Completed 2022 event research with primary-source verification, localized narrative, portrait decision, original explainer and audience quiz.
notes.zh: 已完成 2022 年事件研究，包括一手资料核验、双语正文、肖像选择结论、原创解释图和观众 quiz。
